nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Zero-Cast Moisturizing Finish Sunscreen

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin found the finish heavy and greasy rather than glowy, with product feeling like it sat on top of the skin; another reviewer who previously had sunscreen dry out her face reports this one leaves it soft and moist all day.

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports no breakouts and says her skin looks healthier with regular use, crediting it for solving prior breakout issues from other sunscreens.

aspects.libelle: No stinging or irritation on application

extraits.texte: This sunscreen is broad spectrum not PA 50++++ it doesnt have the proper filters. This will be the same as any american sunscreen.

As someone with really dry skin, I typically lean towards hydrating sunscreens that give a glow, so I was excited to give this a go. It's texture is med-light weight (great), slippy, and greasy. On my face it felt really heavy & it'd looked greasy - not glowy. It also felt like the product was sitting on top of my skin the entire time & made reapplying feel like a chore.

extraits.titre: Great sunscreen, screw cap falls apart
extraits.texte: Love this sunscreen, I've purchased it twice and I love how it blends into my skin. The only downside is the cap tends to crack wnd break apart over time.

extraits.titre: I Think I Just Found My Sunscreen!
extraits.texte: Wanted to try it out for a while now, and it did not disappoint. Spread like a dream, and no irritation for me whatsoever which is unusual. No stinging eyes even apply carelessly. I look a bit greasy though but I am fine with that since it is 80 mins waterproof. Nice package and container btw. Overall, I definitely see myself repurchasing it!

I hated puting Sunscreen on my face because it dried out my face too much, broke me out or looked greasy. I heve been on tne hunt for a face sunscreen that i liked for years and was always disappointed. Untill now!! This is the sunscreen i have been looking for! My face feels helathy soft and mosist all day long. Under my makeup or by it's self. It also makes my makeup sit smothly on my skin so it's perfect. I dont brake out using this either and my skin looks healthier with it. 💜

love this! love the brand! works underneath make up and when I was just looking for something new because my old one wasn't looking good uner make up.. I am a red head so it's important to have something good.

I wanted to get some sunscreen to wear at work with the temperatures getting warmer and me constantly being outside. I love how smooth it makes my face feel! It does smell a tiny bit like your everyday sunscreen, but it's not super strong and it doesn't have a bad smell to it. I, personally, highly recommend this sunscreen!

reserve: Only seven reviews are available and most skin types and concerns are mentioned by a single reviewer at most, so conclusions are tentative.
